source_snapshot.items: AC Reboot - usbPoll() - Check USB on the bus
source_snapshot.procedure: wat_runner.py BMC_IP --cycles 250 -s AC BMC_P DC OS OS_I BMC_I.
source_snapshot.criteria: System workable and no system-log error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Calls the case AC reboot with usbPoll but proposes a command that omits the source AC token.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED until corrected scenario, USB identity/path/speed baseline and exact AC method are approved.

old_problem: The source AC-reboot USB polling stimulus conflicts with the proposed WAT token sequence; neither the proprietary AC operation nor the connector/device/controller acceptance matrix is authoritative.
disposition_reason: ED-03 prohibits guessing vendor scenario parameters, ED-06 and ED-18 preserve physical AC semantics, and ED-19 preserves this USB-specific coverage. Runtime USB mappings cannot cure an unresolved destructive command contract.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row86 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3109 and actual next row87/history3110 were read.
The source contains the AC token but the proposed command removes it; no approved WAT documentation proves identical physical transitions.
USB device count is not an adequate oracle because a device may re-enumerate through another hub/controller or at fallback speed; connector, serial, VID:PID, path and speed must be checked per cycle.
No WAT, AC or DUT action ran; all 250 AC cycles and the distinct usbPoll purpose are retained.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA WAT 250 AC reboot cycles with per-cycle USB topology and speed polling
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved USB device returns through its permitted connector/controller path at the expected speed after every one of 250 physical AC reboot cycles.
required_package: Owner-approved WAT version/checksum and corrected AC/usbPoll scenario tokens
Rated AC fixture/feed mapping, off/on/discharge dwell and automatic power-on behavior
Signed USB connector/serial/VID:PID/path/controller/speed baseline and allowed re-enumeration
Secure endpoints plus per-cycle readiness/reset/error/abort/OOB recovery contract
test_case.test_command: Do not execute. After approval, run the exact signed WAT AC/usbPoll command for 250 cycles on a dedicated SUT and compare every USB device by connector, stable identity, controller path and negotiated speed while recording resets/errors and BMC/OS readiness each cycle.
test_case.expected_result: All 250 approved AC cycles complete and every expected USB device returns on an allowed path at the required speed without a disallowed reset, readiness, power or log event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable before scenario approval. Afterwards PASS requires all 250 per-cycle USB identity/path/speed/reset comparisons; final lsusb count, DC/warm reboot, fewer cycles or retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT, rated AC controller and explicit authorization
Secure secrets, verified OOB and signed USB baseline
Preserve logs; abort on missing/fallback-speed device, reset storm, boot-loop, power or thermal fault
No automatic retry and no AC/DC/warm substitution
test_case.recovery: Fail fast, preserve the failed cycle and USB topology, stop the AC controller safely, restore nominal power/services through the approved OOB procedure, compare final USB health, and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The source AC token conflicts with the command that omits AC; vendor token semantics remain unresolved.

blocked.reason: The physical stimulus and USB acceptance matrix cannot be inferred safely from conflicting proprietary inputs.
